text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely comprehensive features, making it an 'all-in-one' solution",
    "High level of customization and flexibility for various workflows",
    "Consolidates many tools, reducing tool sprawl and cost",
    "Powerful for complex project management and task tracking",
    "Good value for money, especially for the breadth of features",
    "Strong collaboration tools for team communication"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve due to overwhelming number of features and options",
    "Can be slow, buggy, or suffer from performance issues",
    "Overly complex and clunky interface for new users",
    "Default configurations and AI features can be intrusive",
    "Mobile app often lacks full functionality and can be clunky",
    "Pricing can become expensive for larger teams needing advanced features"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Replaced 'Notifications can be overwhelming and difficult to manage' with 'Default configurations and AI features can be intrusive' because the 'Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated' note showed a more specific and immediate type of intrusiveness than just notifications, and 'first-session friction' was to be replaced with a 'long-term reviewer' theme."
  ]
}

pros: Extremely comprehensive features, making it an 'all-in-one' solution
High level of customization and flexibility for various workflows
Consolidates many tools, reducing tool sprawl and cost
Powerful for complex project management and task tracking
Good value for money, especially for the breadth of features
Strong collaboration tools for team communication
cons: Steep learning curve due to overwhelming number of features and options
Can be slow, buggy, or suffer from performance issues
Overly complex and clunky interface for new users
Default configurations and AI features can be intrusive
Mobile app often lacks full functionality and can be clunky
Pricing can become expensive for larger teams needing advanced features
changed: Replaced 'Notifications can be overwhelming and difficult to manage' with 'Default configurations and AI features can be intrusive' because the 'Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated' note showed a more specific and immediate type of intrusiveness than just notifications, and 'first-session friction' was to be replaced with a 'long-term reviewer' theme.
